basics.name: Andrés Peña Castillo
basics.headline: Site Reliability Engineer | Serial Entrepreneur | 10+ Years in Tech

summary.content: Site Reliability Engineer and serial entrepreneur with over 10 years of experience, having worked at IBM, Western Union, Roche, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, and Provectus. Expertise in Site Reliability Engineering (Cloud and Clusters Management using GitOps), Patch Management, and Endpoints Administration. CTO and co-founder of startups in EdTech, AgriTech, and Web3.

highlights: Administered Red Hat OpenShift across multiple AWS clusters, editing CRDs and operators
Deployed MAS application upgrades using ArgoCD GitOps workflows
Application observability with IBM Instana and Grafana
Real-time incident response using PagerDuty and On Call Manager
Built Bash automation for OpenShift and WebSphere data recovery
Documented Disaster Recovery scenario for Db2U on OpenShift
Automated Patch Management workflows for Windows and macOS
Upgraded +1,100 endpoints from Windows 10 v1703 to 21H2
